title: Question 13
passage:
Can we print today’s packing list at the dispatch desk now?
A. The dispatch desk is beside the loading door. B. Yesterday’s printed copy went with the cartons. C. The list is open, but the printer still isn’t connected.
passageZh:
我們現在可以在出貨櫃檯印今天的裝箱清單了嗎？
A. 出貨櫃檯就在裝貨門旁。 B. 昨天印好的清單已經跟那批紙箱一起送出。 C. 已開啟清單，但印表機還沒連線。
